metaphors.title: Slot machine for conjectures
metaphors.paraphrase: Outputs are now mispriced; the dominant career strategy becomes pulling the slot-machine lever on conjectures.

metaphors.title: Atrophying organs
metaphors.paraphrase: Organs of the community like MathOverflow are atrophying, cannibalized by Discord and then AI.

metaphors.title: Lab science with agents
metaphors.paraphrase: Human mathematicians directing compute, doing lab science with agents.
